$comment: SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 ComradeArt / SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later. The update fixture's version marker, and nothing else. It exists so that an N+1 image differs from N in a way that is harmless, identifiable inside a deployed system, and honest about being a test fixture. schemas/ is copied into /usr/share/bunny-os/schemas, so a change here changes the artifact — which is the point: the N+1 image must be a real, separately qualified build, not an arbitrary image handed to the update path.
title: Qualification update marker

fixtureGeneration.description: N is 0; each qualified update fixture increments it. The only field the update fixture changes between generations.

purpose.description: Why this marker exists, carried in the image so an installed system can say what it is.

notAFeature.description: A statement that this marker is qualification scaffolding and carries no product behaviour.
